scientific_integrity: The proof supplies path identities and explicit roots for all allowed zero patterns; prime-field finite tests do not prove the all-field statement; external historical priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers odd prime characteristic and only size p+3; finite-field cardinalities require q to be a power of p. It does not determine individual power-map fiber multiplicities or general larger sizes.
